guidelines.description: Use a confident, friendly, and professional tone that communicates value without sounding exaggerated or aggressive.
Use clear, consistent product terminology. Refer to the platform as BrandPulse AI and describe its capabilities as AI-powered brand insights and analytics.
Write in plain language, expand unfamiliar acronyms on first use, provide descriptive link text, and avoid relying on color alone to convey meaning.
Ensure every product claim is supported by verified documentation or approved evidence. Never invent performance metrics, customer testimonials, certifications, or guarantees.
Use respectful, inclusive, and gender-neutral language. Avoid stereotypes, discriminatory assumptions, and language that excludes users based on background or ability.
guidelines.source: BrandPulse AI Inclusive Communication Guide v1.0

guidelines.description: Keep headlines concise, use sentence case, break complex information into readable sections, and use bullet points when presenting multiple product benefits.
guidelines.source: BrandPulse AI Content Style Guide v1.0

approvedFacts: BrandPulse AI helps teams organize brand insights in one workspace.
The platform provides AI-assisted analysis of brand-related data.
Users can explore trends through configurable analytics dashboards.
BrandPulse AI supports collaborative workflows for marketing teams.
Reports can be organized to support internal reviews and decision-making.
Product features and availability may vary by subscription plan.

forbiddenTerms.reason: Promises a specific business outcome that cannot be universally guaranteed.
forbiddenTerms.suggestedReplacement: Designed to support better-informed business decisions

forbiddenTerms.reason: Uses vague, exaggerated language without providing measurable evidence.
Uses unnecessarily aggressive language that conflicts with the brand's collaborative tone.
Implies flawless results and zero effort, creating unrealistic expectations.
Makes an unsupported absolute accuracy claim about AI-generated results.
forbiddenTerms.suggestedReplacement: AI-assisted insights that can be reviewed and validated
